bulkSection.title: Large-Volume ID Card Printing for Institutions
bulkSection.description: IDGen supports bulk personalized ID card printing for organizations that need hundreds or thousands of cards in a single project.
bulkSection.rightTitle: For bulk orders, the challenge is not simply printing a large number of cards.
bulkSection.factorEquation: Data + Photographs + Design + Identification Numbers + Card Layout + Production + Quality
bulkSection.footerNote: That's why IDGen follows a structured workflow for personalized projects.

steps.title: Requirement
steps.body: We understand: Card type, Quantity, Organization, Required information, Design requirements, Card specification, Additional requirements.

steps.title: Data Preparation
steps.body: For personalized orders, customer information and photographs are prepared for production. Data may be supplied by the organization or collected through IDGen Studio, where applicable.

steps.title: Design Preparation
steps.body: The required card artwork is prepared according to the organization's branding and specifications.

steps.title: Data & Design Preview
steps.body: Where applicable, the customer can review the personalized information and card design before production.

steps.title: Approval
steps.body: Production proceeds after the required information, artwork and specifications are approved.

steps.title: Card Printing
steps.body: Approved cards move into the production process with edge-to-edge high-definition color profiling.

steps.title: Quality Check
steps.body: Finished cards are checked against the applicable approved requirements and data records.

steps.title: Accessories & Assembly
steps.body: If required, the cards can be combined with appropriate identification accessories: ID Card → Holder → Hook → Lanyard.

steps.title: Packaging & Dispatch
steps.body: Completed orders are sorted, batch-packaged and prepared for express dispatch across Assam and the Northeast.

faqsSection.title: ID Card Printing FAQs
faqsSection.lede: Common questions about card materials, bulk turnarounds, personalization and accessories.

faqs.q: What type of ID cards does IDGen print?
faqs.a: IDGen provides customized identification cards for students, employees, staff, institutions, visitors, members, events and other organizational applications.

faqs.q: Does IDGen provide PVC ID card printing?
faqs.a: Yes. IDGen provides customized PVC ID card printing for organizational identification requirements.

faqs.q: Does IDGen handle bulk ID card printing?
faqs.a: Yes. Bulk and institutional ID card printing is an important part of the service, including large personalized batches.

faqs.q: Can I print photographs and names on the cards?
faqs.a: Yes. Personalized information such as photographs, names, identification numbers and organizational details can be included according to the approved design.

faqs.q: Can I order only the ID card?
faqs.a: Yes. Organizations can order ID cards without accessories if they already have their own holders, hooks or lanyards.

faqs.q: Can I order ID cards with lanyards?
faqs.a: Yes. ID cards can be combined with suitable holders, hooks and custom printed lanyards.

faqs.q: Can I get a complete ID card set?
faqs.a: Yes. Depending on the application, a complete setup can include: ID Card + Ultrasonic Sealing + Holder + Hook + Custom Printed Lanyard.

faqs.q: Can IDGen collect student or employee data?
faqs.a: IDGen Studio can support digital data and photograph collection for suitable projects.

faqs.q: Can I check the card before printing?
faqs.a: Where applicable, the workflow includes a preview and approval stage before production.

faqs.q: How many ID cards can IDGen print?
faqs.a: IDGen supports high-volume production requirements. Actual capacity depends on product type, quantity, personalization, data readiness and project specifications.

faqs.q: How long does ID card printing take?
faqs.a: The production and dispatch timeline depends on the quantity, personalization, artwork approval and project requirements. A specific timeline should be confirmed when requesting a quotation.
